title: dailymeteo: Python client for the DailyMeteo API and the MeteoEurope1km dataset
description:
dailymeteo is a Python package for daily gridded meteorological data at a 1-km spatial resolution. It retrieves point time series (maximum, minimum and mean air temperature and precipitation; daily, monthly, annual values and long-term means) from the DailyMeteo API for Europe, Asia, Africa, North and South America and Oceania, and it lists, downloads and verifies the files of the MeteoEurope1km dataset (Europe, 1961–2020) published on Zenodo.

Installation: pip install dailymeteo. Source code and documentation: github.com/srpp011/dailymeteo-python.
